verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own deletion capabilities: storage APIs to delete files, and CLI/API management of rows, files and users. Self-hosting gives full control over where data lives, and storage buckets can strip location, device and capture-time metadata from uploaded images. However, no configurable retention policies, TTLs or automated data-expiry controls are documented. missing for 10: configurable retention periods/TTL or auto-expiry, documented account/data-erasure workflow for end users, retention controls for logs/backups, independent corroboration.
